title: TypeError: ForwardRef.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'is_class' on Python 3.10
body:
On Python 3.10.0, Pydantic 2.14.0 fails when a model with a string forward-reference annotation is defined. Pydantic 2.13.5 works. The package metadata declares Python >=3.10, so installers select the failing version on Python 3.10.0.

Reproducer:

from pydantic import BaseModel

class M(BaseModel):
    x: "int"
